Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Expected monthly volume: ~6M tokens initially, scaling over Q4.
- Key success metrics: latency under 300ms p50, <10% monthly cost increase vs current infra.

- Champion / Day-to-day owner: Sofia Martinez (Customer Operations)
- Economic buyer: Liam O'Connell (SVP Product)  please confirm
- Security / compliance reviewer: Elena Ruiz (InfoSec)  can you confirm contact?
- Procurement: procurement@finovatebank.com (timeline unclear)

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm economic buyer & procurement timeline so we can draft a mutual action plan (MAP).
2) Technical deep-dive / security checklist with our SE (Rishi)  30 min.
3) Share a short champion playbook + ROI bullets for Sofia to use internally (attached).

Hi Sofia / Liam 

Thanks for the clear asks  quick answers and next steps below. Happy to run the 30-min session with Elena if she's available.

Security & compliance (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II: available; we can share the most recent report under NDA (attached: redwood-security-exec-summary.pdf).
- Data residency: hosted regions in US-East and EU-West; Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments available for regulated data.
- Encryption/KMS: customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployments; hosted options use AES-256 at rest + TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- Audit logs & retention: configurable retention windows; we provide per-request tracing and token-level logs (configurable for export).

Typical security review timeline: initial doc review 35 business days, follow-up Q&A 12 weeks depending on depth. We can prioritize FinovateBank for an accelerated review if needed.

Champion enablement & talk tracks (short bullets Sofia can use):
- Exec / CIO: "Redwood reduces agent AHT by ~20% and lowers aggregate inference cost vs self-hosting  we deliver predictable latency and strict access controls for regulated workloads."
- Economic buyer / VP Product: "Pilot shows latency p50 <300ms, scales to peak concurrency with autoscaling, and transparent cost metrics per route."
- Security / InfoSec: "SOC 2 Type II, VPC + customer KMS options, and audit logs for compliance  we'll provide the exec summary and a technical Q&A."

Pilot pricing orientation (3 months): estimated $X$Yk depending on token volume and selected deployment mode  Marissa will follow up with the exact band.

Next steps:
1) I attached the security exec summary (redwood-security-exec-summary.pdf).
2) Please propose 2x 30-min slots next week for a technical/security call  our availability: Mon Jul 26 10:0012:00 PDT or Tue Jul 27 14:0016:00 PDT.
3) Marissa/Neha: I can prepare a 1-slide ROI bulleted summary and a short tech FAQ for Elena.

Calendly (schedule a 30-min): https://calendly.com/redwood-rishi/30min

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
